reports.title: LP Building Solutions Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results Including Record Siding Sales

guidance.heading: Outlook
section:
Fourth Quarter 2026 | Full Year 2026
Siding Net Sales Year-Over-Year Growth | $390-400 million (~3% growth) | $1.66-1.67 billion (~1% decline)
Siding Adjusted EBITDA(2) | $80-90 million (~22% margin(2)(3)) | $415-425 million (~25% margin(2)(3))
OSB Adjusted EBITDA(2)(4) | $(35) million | $(95) million
Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA(2)(4)(5) | $30-40 million | $270-280 million
Capital Expenditures(6) | ~$300 million
(3) This is a non-GAAP financial measure and is calculated as Siding Adjusted EBITDA divided by Siding net sales.

(4) In calculating fourth quarter and full-year OSB Adjusted EBITDA, LP assumes that OSB prices published by Random Lengths remain unchanged from those published on October 30, 2026 (this is an assumption for modeling purposes and not a price forecast).

(5) For purposes of calculating the fourth quarter and full year 2026 consolidated Adjusted EBITDA, LP assumes that other operations will contribute approximately $(15) million and $(50) million in the fourth quarter and full-year, respectively.
(6) LP expects to spend approximately $140 million on strategic growth projects and $160 million on sustaining maintenance projects in full-year 2026.
